$comment: Movement classes (ruleset v0): how each class meets the ground. Cost of a cell = baseCost + slopeCost * slope / 1000, slope in permille (rise over run, 1000 = 45 degrees); steeper than maxSlopePermille is impassable. No spec has set these numbers yet: spec pass S2 does, so the file is marked placeholder. The values only follow tech notes section 3 (siege cares about slope far more than infantry). The water class is impassable everywhere until water depth arrives in M3: its numbers here do nothing until then (changing them still changes the ruleset hash).
